scope: Unsuppressed Taste inspector, entry state only, widths 1440 and 390; run before the focus-only v5 correction.
result: Style findings remain; this is not a zero-failure automated style pass.

decisions.gradient: User-approved chrome/page-ground treatment; each hero-fill itself remains a solid color.
decisions.heavy-shadow: User-approved contained enclosure depth; readable inner surfaces remain near opaque.
decisions.hero-void: Explicit user requirement to reserve future artwork with flat fills.
decisions.blank-gap: Inspected against captures: v3/v5 empty field corresponds to the reserved hero, not a hidden working-state block.
decisions.heavy-borders: Retained technical panel rules; controls have separate stronger borders.
decisions.app-title-size: Short entry heading retained at 30-46px; search remains explicit.
decisions.below-fold: v5 panorama precedes desktop starter rail by design; mobile places starter choices before it.
